narr: Afternoon showers and thunderstorms developed within a tropical airmass. Some storms were slow moving and produced localized flash flooding.
ev: Flash flooding occurred on Beersheba Road, Widener Drive and New Hope Road.
lsr: FLASH FLOODING REPORTED ALONG NEW HOPE ROAD.
